Type: rustic oak sideboard
Use: storing tableware and linens, serving surface; dining room, living room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: solid oak with distressed finish, metal knob pulls
Colors: warm honey oak, antique pewter
Shape: long rectangular case, overhanging top, three drawers over three paneled doors, short square legs, sturdy and substantial
Feel: warm, homely, solid
Goes with: cream walls, linen textiles, wrought iron accents; farmhouse or country dining rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Parson Rustic Buffet Sideboard Storage Cabinet 56"W, Oak Wood
product.description: This beautiful buffet features sturdy, durable construction and timeless oak finish. Its transitional style has just the right touches of traditional and rustic, while concealed ball-bearing glides support smooth, self-closing drawers. 56"W x 18"D x 32"H Hardwood frame and drawers with oak veneer Self-closing drawers move smoothly, thanks to concealed ball-bearing extension glides Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Assembly is required. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
